message.content: The last common ancestor of a lion (Panthera leo) and a zebra (Equus quagga) is the most recent common ancestor of the two orders **Carnivora** (lion) and **Perissodactyla** (zebra). In other words, it is the last common ancestor of the clade that contains both of those orders—essentially the last common ancestor of the clade that includes all placental mammals that gave rise to the lineages leading to modern carnivores and odd‑toed ungulates.
